name: DaveLLM & DaveHarness
head: Compact tools and resizable workspace; project sidebar choice open
statusReason: All 100 approved tools are implemented behind additive gates. The installed app has a searchable selected-tool menu and private starter configuration. Walter now also has Qwen3.5 4B at 32768 context, fully GPU-resident in the observed run; a bounded calc.eval acceptance returned 108 with zero errors. Existing models remain installed and retain the 16384-token request default. Larger-window quality, H9, and provider-specific grants, aliases and helper recipes remain separate gates.

compactWorkspace.scope: Preserve the accepted Tools entry point, make each tool one compact row with one-line details, add saved pointer/keyboard panel resizing and wider ultrawide defaults. Project sidebar behavior remains unchanged pending DL-UI-05.
compactWorkspace.runner: Dominic, isolated Playwright Chromium container, one CPU and two GiB; synthetic APIs and no external networking
compactWorkspace.verification: Six console tests and the synthetic browser matrix pass: light/dark at 1440x900, 375x812, 844x390, 320x256 and 3840x1080; no root overflow; reachable tool rows, filtering/selection, pointer/keyboard resizing, reset, reload persistence and width clamping. Short-window context controls remain accessible. Protected CI and installed-browser delivery are separate gates recorded at closeout.
compactWorkspace.repairsDuringVerification: Removed the old landscape page-scroll exception; added a short-height context disclosure; fixed its summary hitbox overlapping header actions and replaced an undefined menu background token with the existing panel color. Initial PR #83 CI 37626340860 exposed a legacy source test requiring the removed overflow exception (Python 3.12: 1368 passed, one failed). Updated that assertion to require the locked shell and reachable compact controls; replacement CI remains the merge gate.
compactWorkspace.limits: No inference, model changes, provider activation, backend restart, Notion writes or human acceptance. Previous blank-answer and provider-claim defects are outside this UI slice. Playwright is a dev-only regression dependency.

notionTestLifecycleRepair.originalFailure: PR #79 main CI 37587588343 at 2ae84c04620aa2da5353dc0cf44c49fd44c1b088: Python 3.12 Notion coverage failed test_r4_the_token_never_reaches_logs_routes_events_or_the_transcript with Run did not settle; 205 tests passed and one failed. Later green runs did not change the affected fixture.
notionTestLifecycleRepair.problem: The redaction test used a bare TestClient whose per-request event loop could cancel the background run before its approval pause. Neighboring lifecycle tests already retained a persistent portal without starting application lifespan services.
notionTestLifecycleRepair.repair: Reuse the existing _persistent_loop helper in the redaction test and parameterize immediate and gated mocked responses. The delayed case holds its reply until the POST returns, checks that request teardown did not cancel it, then executes the unchanged approval, completion and token/Bearer redaction assertions.
notionTestLifecycleRepair.verification: Dominic, isolated Python 3.12 container limited to one CPU and two GiB: both redaction cases and neighboring approve/reject lifecycle cases passed (4 tests, 3.10 seconds). A negative control replacing only _persistent_loop with nullcontext failed the delayed case with Request teardown cancelled the scripted model (0.89 seconds), confirming the regression detects the defect. Required exact-source CI delivery is recorded separately.
notionTestLifecycleRepair.acceptance: The test must reach approval and completed state after a model reply deliberately outlives its creating POST, with all existing secret-redaction assertions intact. No timeout increase or runtime change.
notionTestLifecycleRepair.limits: The historical CI cancellation stack was not captured, so its exact scheduling point remains unknown. All responses are scripted and Notion is mocked; no inference, provider access, installed configuration, service restart or new live acceptance is implied.

duncanDiagnostic.authorization: Maximum five total serial gpt-oss:20b requests, 128 output tokens and 180 seconds each; CPU num_gpu 0 and num_ctx 4096 first; stop tuning on CPU failure; request-local keep_alive 0; no persistent settings, restart, repull, upgrade, other model, H9, Notion write or paid call.
duncanDiagnostic.historicalConsumption: Zero requests. The controller dispatch ledger did not include BUS-CHOICES-DUNCAN-001, the daily record described it as queued, and the prior Tools100 closeout recorded Duncan as untouched.
duncanDiagnostic.result: Stopped on the required CPU baseline. Ollama launched llama-server with -c 4096 and -ngl 0, then returned HTTP 500 after CPU_REPACK allocation of 10152345600 bytes failed. GPU 4, GPU 8, GPU 16 and the final actual-context DaveLLM request were skipped; no retry or budget reset occurred.
duncanDiagnostic.caps: Request body set num_predict 128, num_ctx 4096, num_gpu 0, keep_alive 0 and stream false; curl enforced a 180-second deadline. The failure returned in 2.9 seconds before generation.
duncanDiagnostic.capacity: Duncan had about 37 GiB free RAM, gpt-oss:20b installed, no loaded model and no llama-server before dispatch. Current Ollama reported no usable GPU for this runner build.
duncanDiagnostic.release: After failure, both local and remote /api/ps returned no loaded models and only the pre-existing Ollama service process remained. No configuration, service, model or file was changed.

findings.title: Tools100 switch-on in the Mac app: launcher settings files and enabled_tools
findings.detail: The launcher now reads owner-only tool-roots.json and toolpack.json from the data folder so a Dock launch gets DAVE_TOOL_ROOTS and Tools100 settings; environment values win and bad files are skipped. DAVE_TOOLPACK_CONFIG gains enabled_tools (exact names or prefix.*), because every registered schema reaches the model on each agent step: the full pack is about 11,000 tokens of descriptions, about 13,700 to 18,300 with the launcher's other tools, against a 16,384 window. docs/TOOLS100_SETUP.md walks through roots, a 13-tool read-only starter, settings-only lanes and the token handling; tokens stay environment-only. Not installed or accepted on the Mac.

history.title: Budget counts tool calls; reply reserve must be positive
history.detail: Codex review on PR #71: the message estimate read only content, so an assistant turn carrying its payload in tool_calls counted as about one token, and the legacy route accepted a zero or negative max_tokens that shrank the total. tool_run_message_tokens now adds every non-content message field as JSON at three characters per token, and AgentRunRequest.max_tokens requires at least 1 (422), as LifecycleRunRequest already did. Plain-chat prompt estimates are unchanged. Seven tests in tests/test_tool_context_budget.py; the new ones fail on the previous commit.

history.title: Tool runs budget for tool descriptions
history.detail: Both tool-run routes now estimate the registered schemas (three characters per token) and refuse with 413 before any model call when schemas, messages and max_tokens exceed chat_num_ctx; lifecycle runs with a project reserve the schema tokens when assembling project context. Five tests in tests/test_tool_context_budget.py; pinned handler provenance and the capabilities manifest unchanged. This closes the gap noted in PR #71; later steps that append tool results are not re-checked.

findings.title: Prompt Lab Library Tests against DaveLLM models need a stateless eval route
findings.detail: Research brief docs/briefs/DL-EVAL-01-prompt-lab-eval-harness.md (2026-10-06). /chat injects the DaveLLM persona and persists conversation, cost, embedding and performance rows, so a clean multi-model evaluation needs POST /eval/chat (no writes, caller-supplied system message) plus a Prompt Lab script that imports the app's own checkTraits and parseEnhancedPayload. A fake-router spike proved the pass/fail, missed-phrase, banned-phrase, invalid-JSON and latency accounting. Milestone 1 (/eval/chat) merged in PR #69; the Prompt Lab runner (milestone 2) and the Prompt Lab half of milestone 4 are in DaveHomeAssist/prompt-lab#131. No live model has been called.

history.title: Milestone 2 built: Prompt Lab eval runner
history.detail: DaveHomeAssist/prompt-lab#131 adds scripts/eval-davellm.mjs: the app's Enhance payload, PII gate, parseEnhancedPayload and checkTraits over /eval/chat, with format json, 10 cases and max_tokens 4096 by default; separate columns for invalid JSON, JSON without enhanced, truncated, empty and tool-call-only; the first-case stop rule; a JSON-constrained note in the report. 12 node --test cases against a fixture router; an end-to-end run through this router with a fake Ollama node sent the 2,230-character system prompt with format json and left DAVE_DATA_DIR byte-identical. Live run (milestone 3) stays Dave-gated.
